title: Decision: limit concurrent relay chains across the operator's projects
body:
Source: t-ahsmyfp measurement 2026-11-16 (.krn/runs/lead/usage/report-before-v3.md): relay-chain links are 48% of 7-day usage (2,616 of 5,414 USD-eq), 564 of 657 outside KRN, started by hand in the operator's projects (~11 live at once at 14:00). KRN cannot cap these without a refusing global hook, which t-ahsmyfp forbids.
Outcome: the operator picks one: (a) a global soft limit: the context-relay launcher (rekurencja-skills relay.sh) refuses a new chain when N chains are live host-wide (default 6), relays inside a chain stay allowed; (b) an advisory only (warn at N); (c) nothing, the chains are the intended workload. Recommendation: (b) first with N=8, measured one week with measure.ts, then (a) if the peak stays above 8.
Proof: krn task show of this task records the operator's verbatim choice, and the chosen variant ships in rekurencja-skills.
Files: rekurencja-skills/context-relay/scripts/relay.sh
